finding.statement: In C66-GEO-COMP, any inertia/stabilizer clause of the form 1→Aut(x_tilde)→Aut(x)→S_6 for a geometric point x of the Abel–Jacobi incidence I=Hilb⁶(C/B)×_{Pic⁶(C/B)}B must first name the stack and the moduli problem, because I is defined without any reference to γ. Over a scheme base every such Aut is trivial and the clause is vacuous; over a stack base the group depends on what the base classifies. Rigidity proofs that pass through 'the automorphism induces a PGL_2 transformation of P¹ fixing the marked images' prove the statement only for Aut(C,γ,Γ), automorphisms of the tetragonal cover preserving the divisor. They do not by themselves prove it for Aut(C,Γ), the group relevant to the forgetful map to M_{6,6}: an automorphism of C preserving Γ need not preserve the pencil, and triviality of the kernel is not formal, since a nontrivial automorphism of a genus-6 curve can fix as many as 2g+2=14 points and so can fix six marked points. Downstream artifacts must state which group they mean before citing such a clause.
